verdict.rationale: BVNK documents an API-driven fiat-to-crypto onramp. Developers create fiat virtual accounts for customers and use `POST /payment/v1/rules` to link a virtual account to a blockchain address, so bank-transfer deposits are automatically on-ramped to crypto. Embedded wallets let this run inside a partner's branded platform. missing for 10: card-funded purchases, an embeddable onramp widget or hosted UI, explicit end-user stablecoin purchase flow and quote documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can embed a fiat-to-stablecoin onramp — a documented widget or API where end users buy stablecoins with cards or bank transfers inside my product

citations.quote: To create a rule that links a fiat virtual account to a crypto blockchain address, send the `POST /payment/v1/rules` request
Automatically on-ramp to crypto and send to blockchain addresses.
Create virtual accounts in USD, EUR, GBP for your business or customers.
Embedded Wallets provide partners with seamless payment and fund management capabilities directly within their platform while maintaining their branding.
Use your fiat balance to send stablecoins, or fund in stablecoins and pay out in fiat.
